content.rationale: Closing a bracket is where S5-marker-append's pair appended in run order — with the position at its post-boundary and the undone count cleared — S5-ordered's order-visibility, and the corpus documents owned by S5-corpus (ylroyrvu) — named here, not claimed — meet; this check drives append over scratch roots and pins that a fresh root's first append lands the appended document exactly, that a further pair lands last in file order, that the undone count is cleared and the bound left standing, that the position lands on the new pair's post-boundary, that an append leaves the marker file and no temporary, and that a corrupt or nonconforming file is refused with the reason carried. It pulls in serde_json and the validator the persist crate needs, so it is a crate of its own; the JSON layer is I1-serde's and the validator I1-schema's.
